limits: Native keyboard and rendered-video acceptance are separate. These are continuous fixed-step solver inputs.
G off driving never initiates assistance on collision. Explicit H/E assistance has independent ownership and is intentionally not disabled by G.
Five seconds after four-wheel handoff are recorded; this is a bounded set, not every city/slope/supply guarantee.
The sampled overhead path is not a swept-volume certificate.
Manual E+1 low-altitude pitch failure and severe 90km/h step nonconvergence are still open.
